scope: Opening image preview only. Main reader unchanged. One final generation, no retries.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. ONE tightly localized pose edit.
Input image: edit target. Only change the SMALL BROWN RABBIT at the FAR RIGHT, currently standing upright. Make that same rabbit RUNNING toward his friends along the path, captured in a lively mid-stride three-quarter view. This is an expressive children's storybook run, NOT stationary standing or sitting.
Preserve his existing intact torso: same cream belly, brown sides, chest-to-pelvis length, body volume, head-to-body proportions. Do NOT erase, shorten, replace or shrink his torso. Lean the intact torso forward slightly into the run; preserve his head, face, ears and friendly expression. Keep him the same size and in the same background location.
Articulate his FOUR existing limbs, do not add new ones:
His two existing forelegs attach ONLY at the two shoulders just beneath the neck. Bend one forward and the other slightly back at chest level for a running arm swing; each has one paw. Both shoulder-to-elbow-to-paw paths must be clearly readable, with no third limb emerging from the chest or side of the ribcage.
His two existing hind legs attach ONLY at the two hips, at the BOTTOM of the long cream belly. Show a rounded haunch at each hip. One hind leg reaches down and forward to land its broad foot on the path; the other bends back at the knee and lifts its broad foot behind the pelvis. The raised hind foot must be visibly connected THROUGH its bent lower leg and thigh to the LOW HIP, never attached to a shoulder or upper side of the torso. Leave a visible gap between the two hind legs, no crossing, no duplicated limbs. No tail-shaped appendage.
Exactly two shoulder-connected forelegs and two hip-connected hind legs, with an unmistakable running silhouette and preserved torso. No fifth limb, no extra forepaw, no dangling upper-body stump.
Preserve ALL OTHER CHARACTERS and environment as closely as possible: PinPin, gray Lulu, bird, butterflies, trees, flowers, path, lighting and composition. PinPin has ordinary brown quills, NO golden quill, and no black speck between eye and nose. Keep landscape 1536x1024, same dimensional storybook style. No text.

inspection.pose: Running motion restored, with asymmetrical foreleg swing and hind-leg stride.
inspection.limitation: Raised hind leg ends in an indistinct rounded shape, without a clearly resolved foot. Fine fur and background textures drifted outside the requested edit region. Exact torso and pixel preservation not achieved.

conclusion: Partial directional control, not precise local anatomy or pixel-level control. Do not classify as a fully verified anatomy correction.
